title: Sea Room
blurb: A calm room full of windows over the ocean, shared by Sprout, a big soft pup with a chocolate Lab's heart, and Sage, a round sage-green cat who does what she likes. Turn your phone to look around, call them with your finger or your voice, and keep a photo diary.
controls: Turn the phone (or ⟲ ⟳) to change the view; tap the floor to throw the ball; hold the floor to call both pets; tap or rub a pet to fill its heart; Talk (or 🎤 on this site) for commands; 📷 photos and 📖 diary; Feed and Nap
